subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive with ML/Infra — scheduling & agenda

Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive with ML/Infra — scheduling & agenda

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and really helpful context on Acme's priorities. As discussed, the next step is a technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so we can map architecture, latency/cost targets, and integration requirements. We recommend 60–90 minutes.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Aug 10: 09:00–10:30
- Wed Aug 11: 13:00–14:30
- Thu Aug 12: 10:00–11:30

Suggested agenda (we can adjust):
1) Goals & success metrics (10 min)
2) Current model infra & data flow (20–30 min)
3) Performance targets, p95/p99, throughput (15–20 min)
4) Deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private) and security considerations (15 min)
5) Integration checklist & next steps (10 min)

Please let me know which slot works and who will join from your side (ML lead, infra/ops, security if applicable). If none of the times work, share a few windows and we'll adapt.

I've looped in Chloe (SE) to run the technical portion. Attaching a short draft agenda and will send a calendar invite once we lock time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

- Elena Ruiz (ML Lead) — elena.ruiz@acmehealth.com

If you can send the invite for Wed 13:00 PDT and include a short pre-read request (system diagram, dataset sizes, auth requirements), we'll get Elena and Marcus to prep.

Subject: RE: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive with ML/Infra — scheduling & agenda

Thanks — confirmed Wed 8/11 13:00 PDT. Quick prep notes for us (internal):
- Bring p95/p99 examples for: small chat model (~1–2 tokens/req), medium summarization workload (~512 tokens), batch embedding workload. Include GPU types and observed cost per 1k tokens.
- Ask for: current QPS, peak burst behavior, average request size, KV cache feasibility (do they have session/stateful patterns?).
- Compliance: confirm whether any data is PHI; if yes, highlight private deployment + KMS flow.

I'll prepare a 1-slide runbook we can drop in meeting: connection checklist, required API/network ports, auth options (API keys vs mTLS), and sample perf numbers. Dylan — can you pull the health-sector p95/p99 reference numbers and a short note on quantization/INF types?

On Wed we'll open with goals, then deep dive into infra, then ops & security.

-Chloe
